summaries.zh: The see tool for the DeepSeek Harness: offline OCR with positions (macOS Vision) + ASCII layout art (PIL) + vision-model semantic description (mimo-v2.5 via the opencode-go gateway). Works with any model, including text-only ones.
summaries.en: The see tool for the DeepSeek Harness: offline OCR with positions (macOS Vision) + ASCII layout art (PIL) + vision-model semantic description (mimo-v2.5 via the opencode-go gateway). Works with any model, including text-only ones.
